sec: Classification of hepatic vascular disease; BCS pathogenesis, site, causes, classification

items.q: Opening classification — match — 1) Extrahepatic 2) Intrahepatic pre-sinusoidal 3) Post hepatic … A) 3rd order vein B) 1st order portal vein involvement C) Hepatic venous obstruction
items.exp: Extrahepatic: 1st order portal vein involvement; Pre-sinusoidal: 3rd order vein; Post hepatic: hepatic venous obstruction. (Book p1033)

items.q: Fill up: The extrahepatic entity is Extrahepatic portal vein occlusion (______), described as ______.
items.exp: 'Extrahepatic portal vein occlusion (EHPVO). • Non cirrhotic'. (Book p1033)

items.q: Intrahepatic sub-types — match — 1) Pre-sinusoidal 2) Sinusoidal 3) Post-sinusoidal … A) Cirrhosis PH B) Sinusoidal obstruction syndrome (veno-occlusive) C) Non-cirrhotic portal fibrosis (NCPF)
items.exp: Pre-sinusoidal: 3rd order vein, NCPF; Sinusoidal: Cirrhosis PH; Post sinusoidal: Sinusoidal obstruction syndrome (veno occlusive). (Book p1033)

items.q: Post-hepatic hepatic venous obstruction is exemplified by which condition, and what does the arrow beneath it lead to?
items.exp: 'Post hepatic: Hepatic venous obstruction: • Budd Chiari syndrome → Cirrhosis.' (Book p1033)

items.q: Fill up (BCS pathogenesis): Vasculature — ______ ductule of acinus → right atrium; hepatic venous occlusion / thrombosis anywhere → ______ entry into right atrium.
items.exp: 'Vasculature : efferent ductule of acinus — Hepatic venous occlusion / Thrombosis anywhere → IVC entry into Right atrium.' (Book p1033)

items.q: Site of BCS — match — 1) Hepatic vein 2) Terminal IVC … A) 2nd most common B) Most common
items.exp: 'Hepatic vein : m/c. Terminal IVC : 2nd m/c.' (Book p1033)

items.q: Among the inherited deficiencies causing BCS, which hierarchy is printed?
opts: Factor V Leiden > Prothrombin gene > Protein C
items.exp: 'Deficiency : Anti thrombin 3 > Protein C/Protein S.' (Book p1033)

items.q: Which of the following is NOT one of the six printed causes of BCS?
items.exp: Causes: Factor V Leiden mutation; deficiency AT3 > protein C/S; MPN; polycythemia rubra vera (PCRV); PNH; pregnancy/post partum. (Book p1033)

items.q: Classification of BCS — judge: I Secondary is far commoner than primary (2° >> 1°). II Secondary is subdivided into inherited and acquired.
